_notes.about: Review 3, after lesson 12: no new keys. It mixes what lessons 1 to 12 taught, with the keyboard hidden while typing (edugame.json, the package's settings).
_notes.intro: Page 1, before the keys: anything that doesn't fit on Page 2 (lesson 1: "what is touch typing?"). Leave it out and the lesson starts at the new keys. "title" and "paragraphs"; in a paragraph, **bold** and [E] (a key drawn as a key: [space], [;], [Tab] ...). "picture": "hands" (the default: the hands over the lesson's keyboard), "none", or a picture file in images/ (with "pictureAlt", what it shows). With "hands": "reach" sends fingers to keys ({"lm": "e", "rm": "i"}: lp lr lm li, rp rr rm ri; keys "e", ";", "ShiftL", "ShiftR" ...; the others stay home), and "keys" says which keys show: "letters" (the default), "shift", "symbols" or "all".
_notes.hideHand: "left", "right" or "none": that hand isn't drawn on Page 2, and its column of new keys isn't listed.
_notes.sentenceLists: Up to four lists: name (shown above the typing box, or ""), count (how many to pick at random each attempt; 0 = unused) and sentences. Use real words, and only keys taught so far. Lesson 1 has no end mark because ";" hasn't been taught. Write ⇥ for the Tab key and ↵ for Enter.
_notes.review: true: no new keys are taught. newKeys lists the keys reviewed (Page 2's heading says so), and practise names the lesson that teaches each key (the results page sends learners there).

title: Review #3: The whole alphabet

intro.title: Review #3: The whole alphabet
paragraphs: This review mixes everything from lessons 1 to 12: every letter of the alphabet, the comma and the period.
**The keyboard isn't shown while you type**, so keep your eyes on the screen. Part 1 is about the bottom row, and part 2 mixes everything so far.

advice: Lessons 9 to 12 added the bottom row: [V] [M] and [B] [N] (index fingers), [C] [X] [Z] (left hand), and [,] [.] (right hand).
Curl a finger down for the bottom row and come straight back; the rest of the hand stays where it is.
If a key keeps going wrong, the results page says which lesson to practise again.
